RedWallet XBT 8.0.1 (1795082047)

The iPhone uses the bridge's proof-of-work challenge lifetime, up to two minutes, when requesting a SHA-256 Lightning quote. If the proof expires before RedWallet sends the request, you can manually get a fresh quote. Payment still requires your confirmation.

Invoice sharing opens with a QR image. Switch to text to share the invoice string. The Pay screen has a larger, softly glowing invoice field.
